title: Chow rings, cohomology rings, and point counts of moduli spaces of curves
summary: In this expository article, we present on state-of-the art results regarding three closely related invariants of moduli spaces of curves: their Chow rings, cohomology rings, and point counts over finite fields. We study the moduli space $\mathcal{M}_{g,n}$, parameterizing smooth genus $g$ curves with $n$ marked points, as well as its compactification by stable curves $\overline{\mathcal{M}}_{g,n}$.
